purpose: One-pass, no-tuning transfer evaluation of the already selected synthetic checkpoint on new ArduCopter SITL sessions.
model_selection: none; this protocol does not train, calibrate, or select a model
run_independence: Each mission uses a fresh ArduPilot SITL process and a virtual EEPROM wipe. The harness does not expose or set an ArduPilot stochastic seed; repeated sessions are independent run units but not claimed to be seeded stochastic replicates.
rules: Do not combine these runs with custom synthetic datasets.
Do not fit, tune, or change thresholds using these observations or their labels.
Save every run and condition, including failures and zero-prediction runs.
Compute predictions before reading or joining the ground-truth schedule.
An unavailable or late prediction is a miss in end-to-end metrics.
Do not claim an Evil_Twin condition; this protocol has no wireless simulator or AP association stream.
If the test is inspected and further development follows, archive it as development evidence and freeze a new protocol before evaluating another test.
